alt: An inspector from the California State Board of Pharmacy sent an inquiry on April 1, 2026, referencing complaint CI 2025 112723-CVS #9785, about a buprenorphine/naloxone 4 mg/1 mg film prescription delay on March 15 and March 16, 2026.
full_text:
CI 2025 112723-CVS #9785

Wed, Apr 1, 12:25 PM

Thank you for submitting your complaint to the California State Board of Pharmacy. My name is [Redacted] and I am an inspector with CA Board of Pharmacy. I am reviewing the events you described involving your prescription for buprenorphine/naloxone 4 mg/1 mg film on March 15 and March 16, 2026.

To ensure that our investigation is complete, I would like to clarify a few details:
1. Did you receive the medication on 03/16/2026, and was the fill partial or complete?
2. How many total hours or days were you without medication due to the delay?
3. Did the pharmacy explain whether the medication was ordered, out of stock, or otherwise unavailable, and if so, what were you told?
4. If you have not already done so, please provide:
• Photos of the partial-fill packaging (“sandwich bag” with labels)
• Phone logs showing your calls on 03/15/2026
• Any medical documentation showing impact on your taper or treatment

Your responses will help ensure the accuracy of the investigation. Thank you again for bringing this matter to the Board's attention.

[Redacted]-PharmD, Inspector
California State Board of Pharmacy
(949) 339-0978 | FAX (916) 702-6068 | www.pharmacy.ca.gov
Be Aware and Take Care: Talk to your Pharmacist!
